استحمرا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَرَا (istaḥmarā) /is.taħ.ma.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اُسْتُحْمِرَا (ustuḥmirā) /us.tuħ.mi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اِسْتَحْمِرَا (istaḥmirā) /is.taħ.mi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
